## Bounds

- A repeatable argument may appear at most 1 time(s).
- At most 1 optional flags may be combined in a single invocation.
- These flags are excluded entirely: (none)
- Standard input variation: simple — every `stdin` value must be one of: HUMAN_TEXT.
- File content variation: simple — every file's `content` must be one of: HUMAN_TEXT.
- `stdin` and `content` are required and may never be null.

## Now produce the output

One JSON object per line, in the format given above, for `tee`.

invocation_comparison.denominator: distinct invocations v1's own enumeration produced
invocation_comparison.equivalence: options compared as a multiset of (flag, value) — order-insensitive; operands compared as an ordered sequence; '=' joining, attached short values, and short bundles normalized; shell quoting removed by shlex

form_notes.note: a match counted here agreed on flags, values and operand order but was spelled differently; the spelling difference is reported, never scored

parse_health.injectivity_note: 0 means the equivalence relation merges no two distinct v1 invocations, so the denominator is unchanged by normalization
